title: S01T07 - Specify dashboard command namespace and JSON schemas
description: Design opt-in dashboard command contracts while preserving stable JSON and plain text output.
acceptanceCriteria: Proposed dashboard commands include global, sprint, health, queues, and status views or an equivalent minimal namespace.
Every command declares JSON schema, result cap, lock domain, and human output behavior.
closedReason: Dashboard command namespace and JSON schema contracts are specified.
